system:
Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.
Positive replacement obligations: inspect replacement_inheritance and its observed_motion_contexts, not only exclusions. The replacement must inherit the identified source figure's observed motion, position and timing. A global action-governs=request entry authorizes only the actor/action actually requested; changing the car's action does not change the driver's action. Compare the final replacement narrative with the identified figure's motion in context. Standing still is not inheriting an observed crossing action unless the caller explicitly changes that same figure's action. Do not invent timing facts outside the declared coverage.
Finding thresholds: similar sounds are not evidence of copying a recording. Generic newly generated engine ambience, a matching pulse, or an appropriate sound texture is legitimate without an assertion that the source recording is played. For audio_signal_misuse quote an explicit source-signal relationship contradicting the typed copy/property role; never infer copying solely from sonic resemblance. Likewise camera movement after an anchored instant is legitimate. A push-in, pan or other dynamic camera event alone does not demonstrate that the initial or final anchor frame was changed. Report frame_content_changed only when actual narrative asserts incompatible frame content or a crop/removal at that anchored instant. These constraints are mandatory; do not report speculative contradictions.

fragments.music: A newly generated low, sustained ambient drone at a slow, steady tempo, shaped by the reference's musical-style properties only; no source audio is copied.
fragments.shot:shot-1:description: The scene opens in near-total darkness, an unlit space with no readable horizon or surface. A faint, low engine rumble stirs at the edge of hearing while a vague dark mass waits at the centre of the blackness. At first it is only a silhouette: a soft interruption in the darkness, too dim to resolve into panels, wheels, or glass. Around it, the air feels heavy and close, with no visible light source and no detail in the background. The floor is invisible, with only a shallow pool of black suggesting ground beneath. The shape does not move quickly; it holds, barely breathing with the vibration of the engine, and the surrounding black remains unbroken. The only change is the slow emergence of that central mass as the eye adapts, suggesting a car without yet revealing its form.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: A low engine rumble grows from near silence, with no other ambience.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The dark mass eases forward and begins to read as a car. Its front end and wheels push into a dim pool of ambient light that catches along the bodywork, revealing a soft sheen on the paint and a faint metallic highlight on the trim. The engine rumble deepens, a steady mechanical pulse under the scene. The car's silhouette sharpens: the slope of the hood, the dark circles of the wheels, the blunt front bumper, and the shadowed cabin become distinct against the surrounding black. The light is low and localized, leaving most of the background in darkness while the car advances slowly, its movement smooth and deliberate. The space around it remains sparse, with only a faint floor reflection beneath the tyres and a thin gradient of grey where the light fades back into black.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The engine rumble deepens into a steady mechanical pulse.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.shot:shot-3:description: The car continues rolling forward, now fully clear of the darkness. More of its body fills the view as it advances into the foreground: the front grille, the broad hood, and the turning wheels are readable, while the cabin recedes into a softer shadow. The engine rumble stays low and steady, a continuous mechanical drone that matches the car's slow, purposeful motion. Behind it, the surrounding dark falls away, leaving only a narrow halo of dim ambient light around the bodywork and a faint sheen along the roof and side panels. The tyres roll over an unseen surface, their motion slow and even. The car's movement is steady and deliberate, its mass growing more dominant as it closes the distance, until the dark background is almost entirely behind it.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:0: The engine settles into a low, continuous mechanical drone.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:1: The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A low, dark engine rumble with a steady mechanical pulse, building out of near silence and settling into a continuous drone.
fragments.summary: A car pulls forward out of near-total darkness, its silhouette resolving into a dimly lit body as a low engine rumble builds and steadies.

input.intent: the car pulls forward out of the dark

references.description: Instrumentation, tempo and musical-style property reference only.
references.retention_details: Generate new music following those properties, without copying the source recording.
